seo.description: English upper-intermediate listening test. Films and actors. Watch a video where Watch several actors and actresses talk about acting.

parts:
B1+ English Listening Test

Watch a video where different actors and actresses talk about acting. Match the actors and actresses with what they say. You can see the transcription after submitting your answers.
